title: Chinese Walnut Stir Fry
description: A quick and easy Chinese-inspired stir fry with crunchy walnuts and a hint of sweetness.

ingredients.name: elixir
ingredients.notes: Assuming Elixir is a sweetener like honey or syrup

instructions: Heat vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add garlic and ginger; stir-fry for 30 seconds.
Add bean sprouts and cook until they start to soften, about 2 minutes.
Add chopped scallions and cook for an additional minute.
Add chopped walnuts and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes, until they start to brown.
Add elixir and stir-fry for 30 seconds.
Stir in soy sauce and cook for an additional 30 seconds.
